description: Default capability set for the Termixion main and settings windows: PTY command/channel core permissions plus trmx-48 auto-update (updater/process), external-link opening (opener), the trmx-51 cross-window settings/update events, the trmx-54 start-dragging grant (not in core:window:default) that makes the settings window's data-tauri-drag-region chrome actually drag, and the trmx-64 set-title grant (core:default only carries the read-side allow-title) so OSC 0/2 terminal titles reach the native window. trmx-252 (L13) adds the app-command grants: since build.rs declares an AppManifest, app commands are ACL-governed and every one needs an explicit grant. The 19 here are the commands BOTH windows legitimately need — configuration, themes, scripts, shells, logging — because the settings window is a second webview onto the same configuration. The 14 the terminal alone may invoke live in main-window.json; the split is asserted by name in tests/command_capabilities.rs.
